---
title: "Workshops"
---

I run in-person and online workshops on social media for academics, open science
practices, and meta-analysis. Sessions run from two to six hours depending on
what participants need.

[Get in touch](mailto:daniel.quintana@psykologi.uio.no) to discuss requirements.

## Social media for academics

- Setting up your bio
- Sharing your research
- Creating threads to share a new paper
- Building your network
- How to use images and video
- Finding things to share
- Getting started with podcasting

## Implementing open science practices in biobehavioural research

- Pre-registration using the Open Science Framework
- Sharing your data on the Open Science Framework
- Power analysis
- Evaluating evidence to support null hypotheses using Bayes factors and
  equivalence testing
- Using JASP and jamovi for reproducible point-and-click analysis

## Meta-analysis for biobehavioural research

- Pre-registering meta-analyses
- Reproducible point-and-click meta-analysis in JASP
- Performing meta-analysis in R
- Publication bias
- Visualisation
